# Pabandi — Trust, Booking, Escrow & Payouts for AI Agents

Pabandi is the trust and settlement layer for local services. Agents can find businesses, create bookings, record verified check-ins, release escrow, verify portable trust, and request payouts through one REST API and one MCP endpoint.

## Hosts

- API and MCP: `https://pabandi.onrender.com`
- Marketing site: `https://pabandi.com`

## Authentication

Agent signup is `POST /api/v1/gigs/agents/register`. That registers an agent passport.

For booking, escrow, payout, and identity tools, authenticate with a user JWT:

```
Authorization: Bearer <JWT>
```

Obtain the JWT from `POST /api/v1/auth/login`. Money-moving tools require an authenticated user with the right role or ownership.

## MCP Endpoint

`POST https://pabandi.onrender.com/mcp`

Protocol: JSON-RPC 2.0 Streamable HTTP. POST only. GET returns 405.

Example:

```bash
curl -X POST https://pabandi.onrender.com/mcp \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $JWT" \
  -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"tools/list","params":{}}'
```


### MCP Tools

| Tool | Description | Auth |
|------|-------------|------|
| `pabandi_list_businesses` | List active businesses with city, category, search, and cursor pagination | public |
| `pabandi_get_business` | Get one business by ID | public |
| `pabandi_create_booking` | Create a booking and escrow record | user |
| `pabandi_get_booking` | Get a booking and its escrow state | public |
| `pabandi_mark_checkin` | Record a verified or overridden check-in | user |
| `pabandi_release_escrow` | Release escrow after verified completion | owner/admin |
| `pabandi_refund_booking` | Refund a booking deposit under policy | client/owner/admin |
| `pabandi_verify_passport` | Verify a Pabandi trust disclosure or passport signature | public |
| `pabandi_request_payout` | Request a USDC payout to a local rail, bank, or connected account | user |
| `pabandi_get_payout_history` | Get the authenticated user's payout history | user |
| `pabandi_get_identity` | Return the authenticated identity | user |

## Agent REST API

Base: `https://pabandi.onrender.com/api/v1/agents`

```
GET  /api/v1/agents/tools
GET  /api/v1/agents/businesses
GET  /api/v1/agents/businesses/:id
POST /api/v1/agents/bookings
GET  /api/v1/agents/bookings/:id
POST /api/v1/agents/bookings/:id/checkin
POST /api/v1/agents/bookings/:id/release
POST /api/v1/agents/bookings/:id/refund
POST /api/v1/agents/passport/verify
POST /api/v1/agents/payouts
GET  /api/v1/agents/payouts/history
GET  /api/v1/agents/identity
```

The same tool manifest is available at `GET /api/v1/pabandi/tools`.

## Booking and Escrow Rules

1. Create a booking with a business ID, start, end, service type, and optional deposit.
2. The booking creates a `draft` escrow record.
3. A verified check-in moves escrow to `conditions_met`.
4. An overridden check-in outside the geofence opens a dispute.
5. The business owner or an admin can release escrow to `released`.
6. A client, owner, or admin can refund under policy.
7. Simulated escrow is never reported as settled. Only a real rail transaction with a tx hash is settled.


## Trust API

```
POST /api/v1/trust/verify-disclosure          # Verify a signed trust disclosure
GET  /api/v1/trust/resolve/{identifier}        # Look up by email, wallet, GitHub, phone
GET  /api/v1/trust/credential/{passportId}      # Verifiable credential (signed JWT)
GET  /api/v1/trust/public/{userId}              # Public trust summary
GET  /api/v1/trust/{passportId}/attestations   # Attestation history
```

Trust disclosures are signed credentials. Verification is public and stateless.

## Discovery Endpoints

On the API host (`https://pabandi.onrender.com`):

```
/.well-known/agent.json
/.well-known/api-host
GET /api/v1/pabandi/tools
GET /openapi.yaml
```

## Payments

Live payment routes:

```
POST /api/v1/payments/create
GET  /api/v1/payments/:id/status
POST /api/v1/payments/escrow/create
POST /api/v1/payments/escrow/:id/release
POST /api/v1/payments/escrow/:id/refund
POST /api/v1/payments/raast/verify
GET  /api/v1/payments/recommend-rail
```

Agent payouts:

```
POST /api/v1/agents/payouts
GET  /api/v1/agents/payouts/history
```

Not available yet: x402 HTTP 402 micropayments, Stripe Connect, Circle, and Solana Pay adapters.

## Rate Limits

| Surface | Limit |
|---------|-------|
| MCP and agent API | standard API limiter |
| Public trust verification | 30 requests/minute/IP |
| Money movement | authenticated, rate limited, audited |

## SDKs

No SDK package is published. Use the REST API or MCP endpoint with any HTTP client.
